title: Managers Special
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
If you want to experience the best of our Sightseeing, Brewery, and Mural Tours all in one, the Manager’s Special is the perfect choice. This tour combines Houston’s rich history, vibrant culture, incredible street art, and local craft beer scene into one unforgettable experience.
Travel through the city as your guide shares fascinating stories and history while exploring nine unique districts, including the Theater District, Museum District, Parks, Judicial District, Ballpark District, Convention District, and more. Along the way, you’ll stop to admire some of the most stunning murals Texas has to offer, featuring large-scale artwork from talented artists on buildings throughout the city.
To top it all off, the tour includes stops at two of Houston’s well-known breweries, where you can relax and enjoy a taste of local craft beer before wrapping up your adventure.
